entities.summary: Estádio Onésio Brasileiro Alvarenga, also known as Estádio Vila Nova, or Estádio OBA, is a multi-use stadium located in Centro neighborhood, Goiânia, Brazil. It is used mostly for football matches and hosts the home matches of Vila Nova Futebol Clube. The stadium has a maximum capacity of 11,788 people.
